changes: Water quality from Not So Weekly Shorts works in the editor: Low draws water flat and in one piece
Desert, Rally and Snow cars keep your paint colour with every car body, not only the Classic one
Rivers and other water lag less
Big tracks load faster and use less memory
Lock cursor key works in the editor in Not So Weekly Shorts
While locked, the mouse turns the camera and blocks go down in the middle of the screen
Bumpers only kick when you touch them, flying over one does nothing
One hit on a patch of bumpers doesn't keep kicking you around in the air
The Bumper label just flashes now instead of counting down
Tracks with lots of water lag way less
Restarting and setting off on big tracks doesn't freeze for a moment anymore
Very big rivers don't show see-through walls between their water blocks anymore
Auto deco no longer lists everything it placed
Desert car has its open tube back again, with bare rear wheels
Finished test runs show up in Runs and Auto deco again, even after you reset or leave right away
Test run lines stop at the finish, so driving after it until you reset does not count
New Auto deco tab in the editor: pick a theme and it decorates your track with ground, hills and scenery
Auto deco is a nerfed version of a private autodecorator, with the same idea but a different execution
Auto deco asks for a test run first so it knows where you drive
New Scenery category under Grass with 39 rocks, trees, plants, buildings and roadside blocks
Scenery is solid, except tall grass which you drive through
Scenery can be recolored with the same colors as normal blocks
Decorate before you set times, ghosts from the bare track can break on the decorated one
Fine grid: the blue cells on the block you are placing are half size too, so they match where it snaps
Rally car doesn't scrape and shake in bobsleigh curves anymore
Desert car doesn't scrape and shake in bobsleigh curves anymore
Fine grid: the grid button now has a third step, and Better Editor blocks move half a small step on it
Desert car has a new trophy truck body
Wheel info shows Road on a stock road under a Better Editor block, instead of Penalty grass
Bobsleigh: cars go straight over the top of a wall instead of rolling along the edge
Gentle slopes, a 3 x 4 block and penalty grass blocks in every kit
Overlapping water and finish blocks don't look darker anymore
Stacked pillars have no gaps
